## Contract review

Served-tier: `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`
Head-sha: `4453fb160442da50e7e35418c15f91a2fce30cef`
Local-runs: none
Scope: .claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/dispatch-runbook.md, .claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/reading-discipline.md + none

Read: card #32855 body and both comments (claim 6837241894, dev report 6837491698); PR #32866 body, file list (2 files, +5 −5) and the net diff `origin/main...4453fb16` (merge-base = `origin/main` tip 5c0f1134); the head's check-runs at 2026-11-12T22:23Z. Nothing built, run or re-run.

Gate verdicts (check-runs on this head, 47 total): 18 `success`, 25 `skipped`, 0 failed. **4 still `in_progress`**: `Lint · repo & tooling gates`, `Lint · CI, release & engine gates`, `Lint · docs & code guards`, `Lint · PM dispatch-gates`. The line-ratchet and id-lint verdicts ride in those, so they are NOT yet a gate reading; this record's budget finding below is a read of the tree, not a substitute. Landing still waits on their `conclusion: success`.

### ① Derived judgments

1. `dispatch-runbook.md:130` — the cost of opening a thread is now "re-clone, re-read `os-dev.md`", the skill dropped. **Right**: it is the cost statement that follows from :143; leaving "重读技能" would have contradicted the new ⛔.
2. `dispatch-runbook.md:143` — a card thread reads `os-dev.md`, the dispatch order, the card and all comments; ⛔ not `SKILL.md`; references on demand. **Right** against Part 1. The card's 「只读」 is not carried as a word; correct to drop it, because `os-dev.md:21` binds the thread to AGENTS.md before its first edit and an "only" would have contradicted that. The explicit ⛔ on `SKILL.md` carries the order.
3. `reading-discipline.md:6` — the fact table is grepped at the moment of the operation, only the hit segment read, ⛔ not whole. **Right** against Part 2; "at the moment of use" survives as 「操作时」. Workable against the file as it is on this head (458 lines, five `##` sections, and every inbound pointer names a section or a quoted lead phrase).
4. `reading-discipline.md:34` (new) — patrol and probe reads of GitHub name their fields (`gh api --jq`), ⛔ no whole issue/PR JSON or full comment text into context. **Right** against Part 3; scope words 「巡查与探针」 are present, so report collection, claims and rulings are not caught.
5. `reading-discipline.md:35` (new) — CI logs saved then grepped, ⛔ not tail-only; claim and contract review still read the whole card/PR thread; long threads per the runbook. **Right in content**, agrees with `platform-readings.md:297` (tail returns only the teardown) and `dispatch-runbook.md:58–60`. Clause order is a should-fix, see ④-a.
6. Deletion of 「⛔ 不用共享检出的工作树核验 main…」 — **right, no rule lost**; see ③.
7. Deletion of 「放行认门禁 job 的结论(`completed: success`),⛔ 不认聚合读数。」 — **right, no rule lost**; see ③.
8. Implied and unwritten: `board-snapshot.mjs` is not named anywhere in `.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/**` or AGENTS.md on this head and the diff does not introduce it. **Right** (the card's ⛔ is "do not route reads through it", satisfied by silence).

### ② Semver level

`.claude/**` only; nothing published changes. `skip-changeset` is on the PR and `Check Changeset` concluded `success`: **matches**. `Clause-②: no` on the PR body agrees with the claim's `Clause-②: no` and with the diff (no accept-set widened, no public surface touched). `Metadata-protocol: none` likewise. No level owed.

### ③ Boundary flags

- **Deviation 1 — maintainer's words in the PR body, not in the skill text.** Answered: accepted. The Acceptance line is satisfied by its operative half (the three parts are in the skill text); a quotation in the rule lines would cost lines both files do not have (37/37, 245/245) and the words are not an operative test of any of the five lines. The citation is durable on the card body (verbatim, with UTC stamps) and on the PR body; the PR body's quotations match the card's character for character. Not verified against the project thread itself, which is outside this review's inputs. Nit on the account only (not the tree): the PR body lists 「把共用的部分压成一页摘要」 among "words this card carries", which is the one measure the card says was NOT adopted.
- **Deviation 2 — :143 drops 「仓 `.claude/agents` 类型未加载(实测)」.** Answered: accepted for this PR, with a should-fix follow-up (④-c). The operative half stays, but the measured reading is now in no file on this head: a search of `.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/**`, `.claude/agents/**` and AGENTS.md for it returns only `execution-duties.md:100` (the `subagent_type` of the in-seat path), which is a different fact. It was the reason the line exists.
- **Deviation 3 — the lane digest was read once and then ignored.** Answered: nothing in the diff depends on it; no action.
- **Paying cut A — the shared-checkout line.** Truly restated, in force: `reading-discipline.md:5` keeps the prohibition (「⛔ … 不取本地工作树」) and `:7` keeps the positive form (verify main with `origin/main`: fetch, then `git grep … origin/main` / `git show origin/main:PATH`), both in the same file and read at the same moment. The reason clause (HEAD moved by other agents) is in AGENTS.md Prime Directive #11 (:233–234, "the shared tree has its HEAD switched and reset *under you*"). Not word for word; nothing operative is lost.
- **Paying cut B — the job-conclusion line.** Truly restated, in force, split across two homes: AGENTS.md multi-agent §7 (:504) "Green means the gate-carrying jobs' `conclusion` is `success` — not 'no failure yet'; `in_progress` is not a pass"; `platform-readings.md:38` 「聚合读数(`blocked`/`dirty`)只作阴性筛查再定位;放行按名定向读单条 job」. Reach note, nit: the aggregate half now lives only in the fact table that Part 2 makes grep-on-demand; a seat clearing a PR greps the queue section and hits it, and AGENTS.md §7 is always loaded, so the rule stands.
- No flag escalated.

### ④ Design judgment

Budgets, read off the tree: `reading-discipline.md` 37 lines on main, 37 on head (ceiling 37); `dispatch-runbook.md` 245 → 245 (ceiling 245). The five added lines measure 109, 118, 118, 120 and 117 bytes; longest line in each file is 120 bytes on both sides. No untouched line moved: no re-wrap. Held. (The gate's own verdict is pending, see top.)

Against the card's three Parts: Part 1, Part 2 and Part 3 are each stated, with their ⛔, and the claim / contract-review carve-out is stated in the tree (`reading-discipline.md:35`). Nothing is added beyond the card. No text in `.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/**` or AGENTS.md tells a thread to read `SKILL.md` or tells anyone to read `platform-readings.md` whole (searched: `SKILL.md`, 读技能, 整读, 通读, every `platform-readings` mention). No must-fix.

- **④-a · should-fix · `reading-discipline.md:35` clause order.** 「认领与契约复审仍整读卡/PR 线程,长线程照 runbook 外包」 joins the carve-out and the outsourcing by a comma inside one semicolon segment, so the nearest reading is "a claim and a contract review read the whole thread, and when it is long, outsource it". The card puts outsourcing with the patrol sentence and the carve-out apart. The runbook bounds the misreading for a contract review (`:60` ⛔ 裁决级阅读不可外包) but `:60` does not name a claim, and `execution-duties.md:11` requires the claim read to reach the last page in the seat. Zero-cost repair, same byte count: 「…⛔ 不只读尾;长线程照 runbook 外包;认领与契约复审仍整读卡/PR 线程。」 Not a must-fix: the carve-out is stated and the pointer target limits the damage.
- **④-b · should-fix (follow-up card, outside this card's file surface) · `os-dev.md` still points into `SKILL.md`.** `os-dev.md:56` 「收口卡定义住 pm-dispatch 报告契约」 (that section is `SKILL.md:278`) and `:356` 「框架唯一副本在 pm-dispatch SKILL.md 〈升级与决策〉」. A thread that follows the :56 pointer now meets an absolute ⛔. Not blocking: :56 already carries the operative rule (fold into the family card, do not open a point card, the seat files), and :356 says the order pastes the frame verbatim. Either retarget :56 to `triage-duties.md:74`, or have the ⛔ read "not whole". Same class, nit: every reference's header line (`dispatch-runbook.md:3` and siblings) says 「见 SKILL.md 的对应各节」.
- **④-c · should-fix (follow-up) · home the dropped reading.** Record "a project thread does not load the repo's `.claude/agents` types (measured)" in `platform-readings.md` (its increments raise the ceiling without a decision card, `triage-duties.md:98`), so that nobody later deletes 「线程读 `os-dev.md`」 on the belief the agent definition arrives by itself.
- **④-d · nit · 「references 按需读」** drops the card's 「按其指针」. Looser by one qualifier; the 120-byte line has no room and the meaning in context is the same.
- **④-e · nit · reach.** `:143` sits in a file the thread is told to read only on demand, so the ⛔ reaches a thread through the seat's dispatch order, as the card intends ("the dispatch order already carries every seat-side fact"). Nothing on this head makes the order say it; the seat should.
- **④-f · nit · `:33` and `:34`.** `:33` orders reads git, payload, REST, MCP; `:34` spells the named-field read with a REST tool. The operative words are 「点名字段」 and the ⛔, which a payload saved to disk and filtered also satisfies; the parenthetical is the card's own wording. Also 「恒」 and 「席位」 from the card's wanted sentence are not carried; no change of meaning.

Counts: must-fix 0 · should-fix 3 · nit 4 (one of them on the PR body's account, under ③).

Head move: this record judges `04d8e278` itself. The baseline is the full review PASS 6837611936 on head `4453fb16`. `04d8e278` is one merge commit, parents `4453fb16` (the reviewed head) and `5fb79bc0` (`main`), made by the relay's `pr_update_branch` after the checkout timeout recorded in 6837992601. It carries no hand edit: the file set of `4453fb16..04d8e278` equals the file set of `5c0f1134..5fb79bc0` (old merge base to new), 85 files.

Read: the baseline 6837611936 in full; PR comments 6837992601, 6838218207, 6838233251; the PR body and labels; the net diff `origin/main...04d8e278` (merge base `5fb79bc0`) and the baseline's diff `5c0f1134..4453fb16`; `5c0f1134..5fb79bc0` for what the merge brought in; the check-runs on `04d8e278`. Nothing checked out, built, run or re-run.

Same change on both heads: 2 files, +5 −5 on each; the two diffs are identical line for line (compared with the `index` lines removed); `git patch-id --stable` is `12786f15c4f6e187d7e76e5cb0da610db7f01c62` for both; the blobs are the same on both heads (`dispatch-runbook.md` `d034f12f`, `reading-discipline.md` `3f516780`), and so are their base blobs at both merge bases (`800287fe`, `924e5dff`), so `main` did not touch either file between the two bases.

### ① Derived judgments

The rule text is the baseline's, unchanged; each line re-read at its position on `04d8e278` and each judgment carried:

1. `dispatch-runbook.md:130` 「…开线程要重新克隆、重读 `os-dev.md`,起步成本不值。」: unchanged. Right (baseline ①-1).
2. `dispatch-runbook.md:143` 「…线程读 `os-dev.md`、派发令、卡与全部评论,⛔ 不读 `SKILL.md`;references 按需读。」: unchanged. Right (baseline ①-2).

7. Deletion of 「放行认门禁 job 的结论(`completed: success`),⛔ 不认聚合读数。」: unchanged. Right, no rule lost (baseline ①-7); restatements re-read on this head, see ③.
8. `board-snapshot.mjs` stays unnamed: the merge touched one file under `.claude/**` (`execution-duties.md`) and its hunk does not name it. Right (baseline ①-8).

### ② Semver level

Unchanged. `.claude/**` only; nothing published changes; no level owed. `skip-changeset` is on the PR. `Check Changeset` concluded `skipped` on this head (the baseline read `success` on the old head): `pr-automation.yml:265–266` on this head names the `skip-changeset` label as the job's exemption, so the skip is the label taking effect, and it **matches**. `Clause-②: no` and `Metadata-protocol: none` on the PR body are unchanged and agree with the diff.

Dispositions carried forward from the baseline, one line each:

- Dev deviation 1 (maintainer's words in the PR body, not in the rule lines): accepted, unchanged.
- Dev deviation 2 (`:143` drops 「仓 `.claude/agents` 类型未加载(实测)」): accepted for this PR; its follow-up is ④-c, now on card #32873.
- Dev deviation 3 (lane digest read once, then unused): no action, unchanged.
- Should-fixes ④-a, ④-b and ④-c: moved to follow-up card #32873 (p2, Blocked-by #32855) by the seat record 6838218207; they do not hold this PR and do not move its head.
- Nits (④-d, ④-e, ④-f and the PR-body account nit): accepted as stated in the baseline.
- Paying cut A (shared-checkout line), re-read on this head: `reading-discipline.md:5` (「不取本地工作树」) and `:7` (verify main with `origin/main`) are in place; AGENTS.md Prime Directive #11 (:233–234) is in place. Still truly restated.

- No flag escalated. Nothing new to flag from the head move.

### ④ Design judgment

What the merge from `main` brought in (`5c0f1134..5fb79bc0`, six commits, 85 files), judged against the lines of this PR:

- Neither file of this PR is touched (blobs above).
- Nothing a line of this PR points to is touched: AGENTS.md, `references/platform-readings.md`, `.claude/agents/os-dev.md`, `SKILL.md` and `references/triage-duties.md` are each the same blob on `4453fb16` and `04d8e278`. They do not speak of what a card thread reads, of how `platform-readings.md` is read, of how GitHub or CI logs are read, or of whether an S mechanical card stays in the seat; so no line of this PR is made false or contradicted. The baseline's two citations into that file (`:11`, `:100`) sit above the hunk and did not move.

- `main` has moved on past `5fb79bc0` (to `bfbcd81f` at the time of reading); those commits touch nothing under `.claude/**` or AGENTS.md. Not part of this head; named for the queue only.

Findings carried from the baseline, unchanged in grade: ④-a should-fix (`reading-discipline.md:35` clause order), ④-b should-fix (`os-dev.md:56` and `:356` still point into `SKILL.md`), ④-c should-fix (home the dropped measured reading in `platform-readings.md`), all three on #32873; ④-d, ④-e, ④-f nits.
